svg.title: The AI-fluent expert
svg.desc: A four-step loop around 'you directing many AI agents': give context, set the goal, measure the result, improve and repeat. Each step maps to a learnable skill: clear writing, problem decomposition, critical thinking, iteration. The loop rests on foundations built at school by doing your own work.

svg.text: Explain clearly what you know, what matters and what good looks like.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: “I'm applying to vet school. Here's my work experience so far...”

svg.text: Break a big problem into precise jobs an AI can actually do.

svg.text: Check, test and fact-check. Never trust, always verify.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: “Which of these claims could be wrong? Where would I check?”
